title: Building – Eligibility of Existing Secondary Suite – April 2023
description: A homeowner applied to the City of Calgary for a building permit for an 'existing' secondary suite, which would let the basement meet reduced life-safety requirements under the City's program. It covers suites existing before 12 March 2018 that have all elements of a self-contained dwelling unit, including a non-portable cooking facility, and no fundamental changes since.

refusal.basis: analogous: building permit refusal under Permit Regulation s.26(b) ('incorrect or insufficient information'); not an SCC variance-form refusal

outcome_summary: The tribunal confirmed the refusal and encouraged the parties to work toward a permit for a new suite, 'including providing alternative solutions as applicable'.
